description: Three stereo core frames and a termination frame of 8 blocks, in 14-bit words, big endian.

skip.ffprobe_packets: ffmpeg's parser takes a sync word as a frame only when the bits after it are those of a normal frame, FTYPE 1 and SHORT 31 (dca_parser.c, IS_CORE_MARKER), so the termination frame is part of the packet before it
skip.decode: ffmpeg's decoder rejects termination frames in every form (dca.c: 'Deficit samples are not supported')
skip.libdca: libdca's sync search reads FTYPE 1 and SHORT 31 in the 14-bit forms and its tool stops at a frame it rejects
